name: Mao
source:
When he was playing hide-and-seek, he fell into the demon realm.

Although he's innocent and embarrassed, he's still a little curious about sex. Features droopy eyes. Daring when pushed?

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100418185018/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/sweet_mao.htm]official website[/url]]
